requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D.
User prefers properties near green spaces. Value set to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to the nearest integer.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area. The 45-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, and the energy class and green-space preferences have no matching reference column. Turin is a geographic constraint handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.
